name: single_source_trust_selection
description: Materialize exactly one observation per stable cell using the frozen H6B source-trust ranking.

input.selection_policy: consume the frozen H6B preview without rescoring

state.history_policy: expire all Iceberg snapshots except the latest after materialization

invariants: every selected row exactly matches the frozen H6B preview
no value or conflict outcome is used to rescore a source
every non-selected candidate has an explicit discard reason
selected and discarded candidates partition the complete H6 workload
prior physical snapshots are unavailable after expiration
